Description

TÜV-GS certified ratchet strap with spindelhook for securing cargo on flatbeds, trailers and in containers. 50mm wide blue polyester webbing with 5 ton capacity and 9 meter total length. The ratchet mechanism allows precise tensioning of the strap.

Ideal for securing machinery, pallets, vehicles and industrial cargo. The spindelhook fits standard lashing points on flatbeds and trailers. Lightweight, easy to use and reusable. Sold per pallet of 256 pieces.

Delivery

In stock and ready to ship. EU delivery within 2–4 business days. Worldwide freight available on request — contact us at info@sorbpack.com for a quote.
